body_markdown:
[Brooklyn](https://www.renthop.com/nyc/brooklyn-apartments) is a popular borough for renters who seek large units, amenities, and proximity to hot spots across the city. Renters can consider Brooklyn listings in October of 2026 under $4,115 and find neighborhoods with unique communities with units below[Manhattan’s](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/manhattan-new-york-ny) pricing.


The average rent for a[New York City apartment](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny) this month has actually increased back to[$4,995](https://www.renthop.com/average-rent-in/new-york-ny) . Now that we are leaving the peak summer rental season, renters must still stay extra vigilant if they want to find a cost-effective apartment. Due to the declining number of options this time of year. The following Brooklyn listings in October of 2026 under $4,115 offer private balconies, in-unit washer and dryer, fitness centers, and more.


## Best Brooklyn Listings in October of 2026 under $4,115


### [1. 1889 Atlantic Avenue #7J](https://www.renthop.com/listings/1889-atlantic-avenue/7j/77212302/show)


Neighborhood:[Bedford Stuyvesant](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/bedford-stuyvesant-new-york-ny)


Price: $3,618


Size: 3 Beds, 2 Baths


Percentage Below: 21.31%


The first unit on our Brooklyn list this month is a modern luxury apartment located in Bedford Stuyvesant. This unit comes with floor-to-ceiling windows that are sound-insulated, a modern kitchen with plenty of cabinet space and dishwasher, plus central ac and heat. The building itself comes with elevator access, fitness center, rooftop, laundry room, and garage parking.


### [2. 250 Melrose Street #1R](https://www.renthop.com/listings/250-melrose-street/1r/77126657/show)


Neighborhood:[Bushwick](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/bushwick-new-york-ny)


Price: $3,995


Size: 3 Beds, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 4.88%


Next up, this spacious three bedroom Bushwick apartment is a must see. It comes with great features such as high ceilings, generous living area, and each of its three bedrooms can accommodate a Queen-size bed, closet, and window. Best yet, residents have access to laundry facilities in the building and a shared backyard.

This next unit has all the luxury amenities a tenant will love. Starting from the unit itself, tenants will be greeted with floor-to-ceilings windows, herringbone wood floors, central HVAC, and washer/dryer in their unit. The kitchen is filled with top of the line appliances and spa like bathrooms. Best yet, tenants have access to a rock climbing studio, fitness center, sauna, and steam rooms. Additionally, there is an in-house pet spa and rooftop pet playground. Finally, the building’s rooftop is amazing. You won’t want to miss out.

This next unit is located in Bushwick and comes with amenities such as hardwood floors, stainless steel kitchen appliances, dishwasher, microwave, and central A/C and heat. Best yet, pets are welcome!


### [5. 3014 Farragut Road #4B](https://www.renthop.com/listings/3014-farragut-road/4b/77186446/show)

Last but not least, don’t miss out on this newly renovated two bedroom apartment with its own private balcony. The unit also comes with stainless steel appliances, hardwood floors, laundry access in the building. Best yet, it’s pet friendly.

## Methodology


Released on a monthly basis, the RentHop Best Deal series aims to provide renters with useful market insights and a chance to identify rental gems currently available on the market. These listings are hand-selected by the team at[RentHop](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny) based on a few factors, including layout, apartment size, features, and, more importantly, price.


Note that, given the fast-paced nature of the rental market in New York, certain Brooklyn listings may receive applications and be taken off the market within days. If you are interested in scheduling a showing or have further questions, please make sure to submit an inquiry via the inquiry submission form located on the listing page.
